comparison: Perfect agreement on device operation claims (C6-C8, C23-C30). Both evaluations find the device worked as expected with appropriate technical documentation. OpenEval provides detailed technical validation while peer reviewers praise improved descriptions in revision.

Complete agreement on histological evidence (C9-C18). Both evaluations support the ability to create lesions with mm spatial resolution and accept the tissue damage characterization across species. No concerns raised about the histological data quality.

Agreement on parameter-lesion relationship claims (C20, C22). Both evaluations accept the relationship between lesioning parameters and lesion volume. Peer reviewers explicitly praise the new figure as valuable reference, while OpenEval notes modest R² suggests variability but adequate sample size.

Significant disagreement on electrophysiological evidence (C31-C32, C34, C38-C40). OpenEval finds claims SUPPORTED by waveform analysis and statistical methods. Peer reviewers rate UNCERTAIN, acknowledging Figure 7 addressed concerns but emphasizing lack of direct histological validation in NHPs and absence of single unit activity loss evidence as major limitation.

Agreement on cross-platform compatibility (C35-C36). Both evaluations support generalizability claims based on U-Probe testing. Peer reviewers explicitly praise applicability beyond specific technical setup, while OpenEval validates technical specifications.

Partial overlap on technical specifications (C43-C45). OpenEval groups these with cross-platform claims (R5) finding impedance calculations sound. Peer reviewers group with cost/applicability claims (R6) and do not question technical specifications.

Divergent evaluations on maximum electrode separation claim (C42). OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN noting speculation without empirical validation. Peer reviewers include in SUPPORTED group with other technical specifications without specific concerns.
Agreement on cost claim (C46). OpenEval rates SUPPORTED as straightforward factual claim. Peer reviewers include in SUPPORTED group without questioning cost estimate.

Minimal overlap on experimental progression claim (C19). OpenEval groups with ethical considerations (R6) as SUPPORTED. Peer reviewers include with electrophysiology claims (R4) rated UNCERTAIN, though C19 itself not specifically questioned.

OpenEval evaluates experimental design and ethical claims (C47, C49-C53) as SUPPORTED with appropriate citations and IACUC approval. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these specific claims.
OpenEval evaluates established lesioning mechanism claim (C37) as SUPPORTED by literature citations. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.
OpenEval evaluates standard electrophysiology methods (C54-C56) as SUPPORTED with appropriate citations. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.
OpenEval evaluates background/motivation claims (C1-C5) as SUPPORTED by extensive citations as established knowledge. No corresponding peer review evaluation found.
